rules.statement: A party is not bound by a final decree in a partition action if proper service of summons was not made on them, even if the irregularity is discovered after the final decree has been entered.
rules.supporting_quote: Where summons in a partition action is not properly served on a party, such party is not bound by the final decree in the case. The Judge can vacate such decree even where the irregularity has been discovered after final decree was entered.
